baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call, doubled تَحْت, prohibition of grief, divine making, and سَرِيّ form one downward-oriented clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible intervention redirects attention downward, where the Lord transforms an underside marked by psychic and terrain-like roughness into a running passage of care.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies the audible intervention that begins the relief mechanism.
Repeated lower location makes downward orientation the ayah's spatial frame.
Psychic roughness identifies grief as a textured state to be altered.
Rough terrain lets the grief-root project the same texture onto the setting.
Transformation into a new state supplies the arrow from roughness to usable relief.
Nurture and completion make the Lord's action sustained care rather than bare placement.
Running flow supplies the material passage made below her.

changed_reading.before: A voice reassures her and points out a stream.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs a downward reorientation in which divine care converts both affective and spatial roughness into a traversable flow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَادَى opens the ayah and سَرِيّ closes the clause of the Lord's making.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split call-root inventory carries sound, wetness, and generosity, while the final running current concretizes the call as a gift; message and provision become coordinated modes of one relief event.

activation_trace.role: The audible call supplies the communicative face of the event.
Dew, rain, and wetness supply a material echo inside the call-root inventory.
Generosity turns the wet echo into a bestowed rather than accidental resource.
Nurturing care joins communication to provision.
The running current gives the call's wet and generous overtones a visible endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Spoken reassurance precedes an independently supplied stream.
changed_reading.after: Voice and water can be heard as two surfaces of one gift: the call itself arrives already charged with wetness and generosity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled language of below stands directly beside a final noun whose inventory includes elevation and distinction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical low position and a branch of social lowness are juxtaposed with the elevation of سَرِيّ; divine making can therefore stage a rank reversal without deciding whether the final noun names a current or a noble being.

activation_trace.role: Literal below supplies the physical low pole of the reversal.
The socially low branch supplies a status overlay without replacing the locative syntax.
Elevation and distinction supply the high pole held beneath her.
Making into a state allows low position to carry newly conferred rank.
The call gives the below-positioned source an active voice.

changed_reading.before: Below is only a location and سَرِيّ only a resource.
changed_reading.after: The clause may superimpose a status paradox: what speaks or appears from the lowest position already bears elevation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Divine making occurs twice within the frame of below and ends on the split س ر ي inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The س ر ي target of uncovering and the mapped س ر ر images of concealment and hidden joy permit the final object to function as an event: relief stored out of sight is made available from the underside.

activation_trace.role: The underside supplies the concealed zone from which relief emerges.
Bringing something into being supplies the transition from unavailable to present.
Uncovering gives the final noun an eventive release function.
Hidden interiority supplies what had been inaccessible beneath the visible crisis.
Hidden joy supplies the affect released against grief.

changed_reading.before: A fixed object is newly noticed below her.
changed_reading.after: The ending can also register an uncovering: concealed relief and joy become operative from precisely where she had not been looking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the prohibition of grief into an embodied regulation sequence: labor's agitation is answered by movement, downward delivery of moist food, eating and drinking, and the settling of the eye.

activation_trace.role: Psychic roughness is the affective state the care sequence must change.
Running flow supplies immediate material relief beneath her.
The pregnant body's disturbance supplies the acute state immediately preceding the call.
Deliberate shaking converts passive distress into bodily action.
Downward falling extends the ayah's repeated below-axis into delivered food.
Moist softness counters the dryness and roughness carried by grief.
Eating turns the provided environment into bodily restoration.
Drinking confirms that the current belongs to an actionable care regimen.
The eye's settling supplies the sequence's explicit affective endpoint.

structural_cues: 19:23 places labor and the palm immediately before the focus call.
19:25-26 continue with commanded motion, downward fruit, intake, and settled vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agitation, movement, falling food, intake, and settled vision; I infer that material support causes affective regulation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent benefits rather than one causal care sequence.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve is verbal consolation supported by nearby water.
changed_reading.after: Do not grieve initiates a postpartum care protocol in which movement, hydration, nourishment, and sensory settling materially produce relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context develops a transfer of speech: a voice comes from below, Mary binds her own tongue, points instead of answering, and meaningful prophetic speech then comes from the infant in the cradle.

activation_trace.role: The raised call establishes speech emerging before Mary resumes public contact.
Below locates the alternative speaking source on the infant's later spatial axis.
Elevation makes a noble child-reading of the below-positioned source available.
Restraint of the tongue removes Mary as the direct public speaker.
Meaningful speech names the channel Mary explicitly withholds.
Hand indication transfers the answering role away from Mary's tongue.
The crowd's question makes intelligible speech from the child the explicit problem.
The prepared cradle fixes the new speaker in a low infant setting.
Infancy makes the relocation of authoritative speech maximally marked.
The child's utterance realizes speech from the low-positioned source.
Prophetic office supplies the elevated authority carried by that speech.

structural_cues: 19:24 introduces a call from below before the silence instruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a below-call, Mary's verbal abstention, her gesture, and the infant's speech; I infer a deliberate relocation of defensive speech to the child. The live alternative is an angelic speaker in 19:24 whose call only anticipates, rather than identifies with, the child's later voice.

changed_reading.before: An external speaker privately reassures Mary before an unrelated later miracle.
changed_reading.after: The call can begin a designed transfer of voice: Mary is defended by authoritative speech rising from the low position she indicates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated جَعَلَ links the promised child as sign and mercy, the focus gift beneath Mary, and the child's later prophetic and blessed status; the focus clause can therefore carry a status-making layer alongside material provision.

activation_trace.role: Making into a state first assigns the promised child a public function.
A visible sign specifies one status produced by the first making.
Merciful tenderness specifies the care-bearing purpose of that status.
The focus making becomes the middle link in the repeated status sequence.
Nurture and completion identify the maker's action as developmental.
Elevation permits the focus object to carry conferred distinction.
The child's own speech resumes the same making construction for prophetic status.
Prophethood names the elevated state produced by the later making.
A third contextual making extends status beyond the immediate scene.
Stable growing good supplies the enduring content of that status.

structural_cues: ج ع ل recurs at 19:21, 19:24, 19:30, and 19:31 around the same child-event.
The sequence moves from promised sign and mercy to the focus gift, then to prophet and blessed presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making constructions and their stated outcomes; I infer that 19:24 participates in the same status-conferral chain. A live alternative is that its making concerns only a stream while the repeated verb supplies thematic cohesion rather than shared reference.

changed_reading.before: The Lord has merely placed a stream beneath Mary.
changed_reading.after: The focus making may simultaneously announce an elevated person whose sign-bearing, prophetic, and blessed statuses unfold in the following speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope frames Mary between remembrance and attempted self-erasure: withdrawal culminates in wishing to be a discarded forgotten thing, while the focus call turns concealment toward announcement, sign, gesture, and a truth-bearing public account.

activation_trace.role: Recall after absence supplies the pericope's opening counterforce to erasure.
Withdrawal to a side begins Mary's movement out of social visibility.
The promised visible sign supplies the public destiny opposed to disappearance.
The discarded forgotten thing states the endpoint Mary desires immediately before the call.
Appearance and notification make the call a hinge from hiddenness toward disclosure.
The grief prohibition interrupts the affect driving the wish for erasure.
Visible indication carries testimony forward without Mary's speech.
Truth matching reality supplies the stable public account reached after the crisis.

structural_cues: The unit opens by commanding Mary's remembrance and reaches her wish to be forgotten immediately before 19:24.
After the call, a visible sign, Mary's gesture, the child's speech, and a truth formula replace self-erasure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the remember-forgotten opposition and later public signs; I infer that the call causally pivots Mary from desired deletion into mediated testimony. A live alternative is that it only relieves immediate pain while the public turn is separately staged.

changed_reading.before: The call stops a private episode of sadness.
changed_reading.after: The call arrests a movement toward social and mnemonic erasure, redirecting Mary into testimony that another voice will carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The family-burden branch of grief is activated by a womb-to-public-carrying sequence and then reversed when the child identifies himself through goodness to his mother; reassurance addresses a threatened maternal relation, not only solitary emotion.

activation_trace.role: Concern for dependents and family burden supplies the relational dimension of grief.
Nurture and completion answer the feared burden with sustained care.
Elevation keeps open the possibility that the reassurance concerns the child's worth.
The womb image locates mercy language inside the maternal body.
Hidden pregnancy supplies the inward form of Mary's burden.
Visible carrying converts the inward burden into a socially exposed one.
Motherhood becomes an explicit term in the crowd's accusation.
Filial goodness repairs the maternal relation under public pressure.

structural_cues: Mary carries the child inward at 19:22 and visibly before her people at 19:27.
The crowd invokes motherhood at 19:28, and the child answers with goodness to his mother at 19:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily carrying, public carrying, maternal accusation, and filial goodness; I infer that the focus reassurance recasts feared kinship burden as a cared-for bond. A live alternative is that the filial statement answers only the crowd and does not feed back into 19:24.

changed_reading.before: Mary is comforted as an isolated sufferer.
changed_reading.after: She is comforted as a mother whose feared dependent and public burden will become the very relation that speaks, honors, and repairs her.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant تندية branch of the call-root as movement between watering and pasture. It remains anchored in نَادَى and is reinforced by the immediate current-palm-date-drink sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a procedural overlay, not as the lexical meaning of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening call and final current bracket an instruction sequence that immediately moves from water to palm food and back to drinking.

activation_trace.role: The water-to-pasture shuttle supplies a routing image latent in the focus call-root.
The running current supplies the watering station.
The palm supplies the nearby food-bearing station.
Ripe dates specify the pasture-side yield.
Drinking completes the return to water within the care cycle.

changed_reading.after: The call may also cue an alternating route between two nearby resource stations, water and fruit, organizing Mary's recovery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from س ر ي to the packet's mapped س ر ر navel branch and treats a stream as a bodily analogy. It remains anchored in the final focus root, doubled below-location, divine nurture, and the context's womb-pregnancy-labor chain, but it should be rendered as an umbilical resonance rather than a proposed dictionary sense or exclusive referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A running thing is made beneath Mary while the split final-root inventory includes the navel and the Lord-root includes feeding and growth.

activation_trace.role: The doubled underside supplies the bodily-spatial anchor for the analogy.
A running current supplies the flow side of the bodily analogy.
The navel branch supplies a hidden maternal-fetal conduit image.
Feeding and growth make the conduit an image of developmental provision.
The womb image supplies the maternal interior activated by the context.
Pregnancy supplies the hidden period of internal nourishment.
Labor supplies the transition from internal provision to external care.

changed_reading.before: The stream is only an external post-birth resource.
changed_reading.after: The external current may echo an internal life-sustaining conduit, marking continuity between gestational nurture and postpartum provision.

strongest_changes: The grief prohibition became an embodied regulation sequence of motion, water, food, and settled vision.
The below-call became the first node in a transfer of public speech from Mary to the infant.
Repeated ج ع ل made a noble-child status layer viable alongside the stream reading.
The call became a hinge from desired erasure into mediated testimony and maternal repair.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ت ح ت and the split inventories of ن د و, ر ب ب, and س ر ي let voice, water, status, hidden bodily nurture, and social reversal coexist without forcing a single referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet leaves the 19:24 speaker compatible with either an angelic voice or the child.
سَرِيّ can sustain a running-water reading, a noble-child reading, or a deliberate overlay of both.
The water-pasture shuttle and umbilical-current models are productive but depend on form-distant branches and require explicit qualification.
